name: Chronos Coral Reef
description: A coral reef shaped like ancient clocks, its polyps ticking with the rhythm of the sea.
prompt: Underwater coral reef where each formation resembles intricate clock gears and hands, polyps glistening as they pulse, deep ocean blue with sunbeams filtering, slow-motion reef life.
caption: Time meets tide—Chronos Coral Reef tells the sea’s rhythm. ⏳🌊
